feature: Interrupt and redirect a running DeepSeek agent (Issue #187 / Agent Node Room Story 2.7)

userStories.title: DeepSeek ACP interrupt seam + pinned-runtime spike
userStories.description: As an Archon operator, I want the DeepSeek provider to accept the executor's turn-scoped interruptSignal and cancel the live ACP prompt exactly once, so that pressing Stop ends the current DeepSeek turn while preserving the persisted session id for redirect.
acceptanceCriteria: interruptSignal?: AbortSignal added to DeepseekAcpTurnInput (flows into DeepseekProcessInput by extension) and DeepseekProvider.sendQuery() forwards requestOptions.interruptSignal alongside, not instead of, abortSignal

Aborting interruptSignal while session/prompt is live produces exactly one ACP session/cancel, one session/close, child reap, and the byte-for-byte unchanged result { sessionId, stopReason:'aborted', isError:true, errorSubtype:'deepseek_aborted' }

requestCancel(cause) records the FIRST cause (node-cancel | operator-interrupt | cleanup) and releases the prompt wait exactly once; flushCancel() is a no-op until clientCtx + activeSessionId exist, then sends/memoizes at most one session/cancel — a pre-session cancellation stays pending rather than lost, and Stop+Cancel race sends no duplicate

A signal already aborted when the ACP session becomes available sends cancel once, skips session/prompt, closes, and returns the abort result carrying the new/resumed session id; if both signals are already aborted, node Cancel is checked first

Cancellation is honored at setup boundaries: cause is checked before each config request, after each awaited config response, and before session/prompt; an interrupt during session/set_config_option cancels once, skips the prompt, closes, and yields the abort result
Natural prompt result winning a Stop race during session/close remains natural — no session/cancel sent, structured output survives (release-guard test)

Both signal listeners are removed on success, prompt failure, setup failure, and early consumer return; early return still cancels a live session and releases the connection (outer finally routes through requestCancel('cleanup') + flushCancel())

CANCEL_DRAIN_GRACE_MS = 500 (matching the Devin ACP pattern) bounds the cancelled-prompt wait: a fake DSH that never settles session/prompt after session/cancel still allows session/close, cleanup/reap, and emits the abort result — covered by a fake-timers test with no new product config knob

abortedResult(sessionId) unchanged — no terminalReason added, 'cancelled' NOT added to INTERRUPT_TERMINAL_REASONS, toDeepseekErrorResult() untouched; node-Cancel-only and consumer-return tests remain green

CONDITIONAL: if and only if the live spike observes an in-flight cancelled tool arriving as ACP status:'failed' before the abort result, DeepseekEventState carries the first cancellation cause and maps failed -> toolOutcome:'interrupted' only for operator-interrupt; normal failed and node-cancel stay error; otherwise explicitly recorded as unnecessary in the report

interrupt-resume-spike.ts created: requires DEEPSEEK_LIVE_TEST=1 + DEEPSEEK_API_KEY + DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL + DEEPSEEK_LIVE_MODEL; runs only in a disposable temp dir it always removes; enforces a total timeout; fails non-zero on timeout/auth/model/protocol/missing-session/resume/continuation failure; verifies installed @deepseek-ai/dsh and ACP SDK versions match package pins; records interruptAckMs, post-interrupt chunk-type/tool-status names, equality booleans instead of raw session ids, and ZERO prompt text, model output, credentials, base URLs, env contents, or raw tool payloads
spike:interrupt:deepseek script added to packages/providers/package.json; script is not exported and not wired into CI

plans/reports/deepseek-interrupt-resume-spike.md written with the operator command, dependency pins, sanitized JSON, Proceed/Block outcome, and the tool-mapping decision; Proceed requires interruptAckMs < 1000, abort result carrying session id, close completing, resumed === true, and a non-error continuation on the same id
DEEPSEEK_CAPABILITIES.interrupt is NOT flipped in this story

Regression gate passes: cd packages/providers && bun test src/community/deepseek/acp-client.test.ts src/community/deepseek/provider.test.ts src/community/deepseek/event-bridge.test.ts && bun run type-check
userStories.technicalNotes: Phase 1 of the plan (phase-01-deepseek-acp-interrupt-seam.md). Read packages/providers/src/community/deepseek/acp-client.ts (esp. :105-113,312-374 driveDeepseekAcpTurn + abortedResult), provider.ts:202-217, event-bridge.ts, their tests, and the Devin ACP cancellation pattern (CANCEL_DRAIN_GRACE_MS precedent) before editing. TDD: add the 10 listed test cases to acp-client.test.ts/provider.test.ts first and watch them fail, then implement steps 1-10 in the phase file. Keep turn state shared outside individual listeners; freeze outcome at session/prompt settlement — a later Stop during session/close must not convert a natural result or send a stale cancel. Keep runDeepseekAcpTurn()'s finally reaper unchanged unless the ignored-cancel test proves otherwise. The spike is a ship gate, not a runtime parser: if live credentials are unavailable in the environment, still write the script + package.json wiring, record a sanitized Blocked/no-credentials outcome in the report, and leave interrupt:false. Never log prompts, model output, tool payloads, env values, base URLs, or credentials.
userStories.notes: Implemented in iteration 1. Files: acp-client.ts, provider.ts, acp-client.test.ts, provider.test.ts, interrupt-resume-spike.ts, package.json spike:interrupt:deepseek, plans/reports/deepseek-interrupt-resume-spike.md. Unit gate 71/71 green. Live spike Blocked (missing-env credentials); tool mapping deferred/unnecessary until live failed-tool evidence; interrupt capability still false.

userStories.title: Executor interrupt predicate, capability flip, and DeepSeek conformance fixture
userStories.description: As an Archon operator, I want both the direct and AI-loop executor paths to recognize DeepSeek's normalized abort result as an operator interrupt and for DeepSeek to advertise interrupt:'native', so that Stop + Send now works identically across Claude and DeepSeek with no provider-id branching.
acceptanceCriteria: Phase 1 gate honored: plans/reports/deepseek-interrupt-resume-spike.md exists and records Proceed (if it recorded Blocked on the pinned runtime, do not flip the capability — implement predicate+tests but leave interrupt false and record why in notes)

One shared provider-neutral predicate isInterruptMarkedResult(result) added beside the existing terminal-reason helper in dag-executor.ts: isInterruptTerminalReason(result.terminalReason) OR (stopReason === 'aborted' AND isError === true AND errorSubtype === 'deepseek_aborted') — no provider-id branching, no prefix matching, no prose/error-message parsing, no terminalReason:'cancelled'

Both call sites (direct ~dag-executor.ts:2688-2693 and loop ~:6409-6414, plus related classification at :452-465) use the shared predicate while retaining existing guards: matching live turn token, wasOperatorInterrupted(token) === true, and node Cancel's established dominance; no other direct/loop control flow changed

Test harness: registerDeepseekProvider() called in dag-executor.test.ts bootstrap, DEEPSEEK_CAPABILITIES imported from @archon/providers, invokeDag() assistant union/config extended with 'deepseek', local fake provider returning getType:'deepseek', real DEEPSEEK_CAPABILITIES, shared mocked sendQuery, and an abortedResult(sessionId) helper with exactly the Phase 1 shape and no terminalReason — nested describe('deepseek conformance'), no generic framework

Conformance test 1 (direct, full contract): live handle interrupt on first turn -> open DeepSeek-shaped tool call + exact abort result -> idle with exactly one 'interrupted' status and no node_failed -> Send now drains older queued guidance then new message in receipt order -> second call receives the interrupted result's session id and completes; open tool has exactly one interrupted outcome; structured-output re-ask is provably skipped (output_format node or call-count assertion); if Phase 1 applied the bridge mapping, a variant emits the terminal interrupted tool result before the abort result and still asserts one outcome
Conformance test 2 (no operator flag): the exact DeepSeek abort result yielded without interrupt() follows the existing 'SDK returned deepseek_aborted' node-failure path

Conformance test 3 (exactness guard): with the operator flag set, a result missing any member of the triple is NOT classified as interrupt — assert normal failure, not idle; verify the test fails if the helper is broadened to one field or a prefix
Conformance test 4 (AI loop): exact abort result enters idle inside the current iteration; Send now resumes the same session id without consuming an iteration, then completes with no node_failed

DEEPSEEK_CAPABILITIES.interrupt changed from false to 'native' with a concise comment noting ACP session/cancel + session/resume on the same persisted id; 'stream-abort' remains reserved for stream-terminating adapters

config.test.ts exact capability literal updated; registry.test.ts native interrupt provider list updated to ['claude','deepseek'] (sorted); ProviderCapabilities.interrupt doc in types.ts updated to include DeepSeek ACP session/cancel + same-id resume as a native example — MessageChunk.terminalReason doc untouched, union unchanged
Existing Story 2.3 interrupt matrix tests remain green with no route/UI changes; no provider-list assertion in dag-executor.test.ts altered by the extra registration

Regression gate passes: cd packages/providers && bun test src/community/deepseek/config.test.ts src/registry.test.ts; cd ../workflows && bun test src/dag-executor.test.ts -t 'deepseek conformance' && bun test src/dag-executor.test.ts -t 'interrupt and redirect'; cd ../.. && bun run type-check
userStories.technicalNotes: Phase 2 of the plan (phase-02-executor-marker-and-conformance-fixture.md). Depends on US-001's spike verdict. The exact triple + operator token + near-miss test are the safety boundary against hiding genuine provider errors racing Stop. Add a comment on isInterruptMarkedResult explaining exact provider-normalized result fields are transport contracts, not prose inference. Register DeepSeek once via the existing bootstrap pattern and check no list-order assumptions change. Do not clone provider-neutral Story 2.3 tests (natural-result races, repeated interrupts, Cancel dominance, missing session id, background tasks, idle discard, both docks) unless the new predicate changes them. Rollback path: capability back to false + remove only the DeepSeek arm of the predicate/tests; Claude classification untouched.
userStories.notes: Implemented in iteration 2. Files: dag-executor.ts (isInterruptMarkedResult + both call sites + instance interrupt fallback), dag-executor.test.ts (registerDeepseekProvider bootstrap, deepseek conformance x4). Phase 1 spike Blocked (missing-env) — DEEPSEEK_CAPABILITIES.interrupt left false; config/registry/types native docs NOT updated; test fake opts into interrupt:'native' only inside the fixture. Capability flip + matrix/docs deferred to Proceed re-run / US-003. Gate: deepseek conformance 4/4, interrupt and redirect 24/4, providers config+registry 72, type-check clean.

userStories.title: Capability matrix regeneration, provider docs, and sprint closeout
userStories.description: As an Archon maintainer, I want generated capability docs and the DeepSeek assistant guide to match the verified interrupt/redirect behavior with evidence linked on issue #187, so that the story can be marked done only after every acceptance criterion is proven.
acceptanceCriteria: bun run generate:capability-matrix run from repo root; diff inspected — the ONLY intended matrix change is DeepSeek's Turn interrupt cell from ❌ to **native**; no other generated cell changes; the generated file is never hand-edited (scripts/generate-capability-matrix.ts needs no code change)

packages/docs-web/src/content/docs/getting-started/ai-assistants.md DeepSeek section gains compact user-facing text covering all five facts: (a) Stop sends ACP session/cancel for the current prompt only and the node stays running in idle-after-interrupt, (b) Send now starts a fresh DSH child resuming the same persisted ACP session id and delivers queued + new guidance in receipt order, (c) Queue does not inject into an in-flight DSH prompt — it waits for the natural turn boundary, (d) Stop is not undo — completed tool/file effects remain, (e) a failed session resume fails loudly — no silent fresh session
Docs do NOT promise a warm process, 31 ms latency, retained uncommitted model text, token/cost reporting, or soft injection

plans/reports/deepseek-interrupt-resume-spike.md confirmed to contain sanitized evidence, dependency pins, a Proceed conclusion, and the tool-status decision; the report plus focused test commands/results are linked or attached on issue #187

Nine-perspective acceptance review performed (product / architecture / contracts / security-reliability-data / performance / completeness / verification / ops-compat-rollback / maintainability) per phase-03 before status change
As the FINAL repository edit, _bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/agent-node-room/sprint-status.yaml changes 2-7-interrupt-and-redirect-a-running-deepseek-agent from backlog to done

Full validation gate passes: cd packages/providers && bun test src/community/deepseek/acp-client.test.ts src/community/deepseek/provider.test.ts src/community/deepseek/event-bridge.test.ts src/community/deepseek/config.test.ts src/registry.test.ts; cd ../workflows && bun test src/dag-executor.test.ts -t 'deepseek conformance' && bun test src/dag-executor.test.ts -t 'interrupt and redirect'; cd ../.. && bun run generate:capability-matrix && bun run check:capability-matrix && bun run type-check && bun run validate
userStories.technicalNotes: Phase 3 of the plan (phase-03-matrix-docs-and-closeout.md). Never run root bun test — package-isolated runs only (bun run validate covers it). If validation or a pinned-runtime rerun fails: leave the story backlog, revert the capability to false, regenerate the matrix, retain the sanitized failure report. Sprint status flips last, after evidence is linked on the issue. Rollback is code-only — no data rollback needed.
